script_text: Aquarius, this week your Uranus-ruled air sign gets a reality check wrapped in romance. Monday, the Sun conjunct Venus in your 5th House turns on flirting and a second chance, but Tuesday's Uranus square Saturn between your 5th and 2nd Houses makes impulsive spending or love promises costly. Best day: Wednesday, your power day, because exact Jupiter sextile Saturn links your 6th House of work to your 2nd House of money, favoring talks and invoices. Mid-week, Jupiter sextile Saturn turns attraction into accountable income. Thursday into Sunday, Jupiter trine Neptune in your 3rd House smooths emails, errands, and client conversations, while Venus enters your 6th House Saturday, making a coworker, client, or daily ritual feel more affectionate. Sunday is softer for rest. Worst day: Tuesday, unless you budget first. Advice: say yes to love, but price the fantasy before buying in. Follow for daily updates.
